items.headline: World Leaders Gather in China for the 33rd APEC Summit
items.summary: Global leaders, including U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin, have arrived in Shenzhen for the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. The high-stakes summit has drawn international attention as leaders hold diplomatic meetings to discuss regional trade, economic stability, and international cooperation.

items.headline: NASA's Voyager 1 Becomes First Human-Made Object One Light-Day From Earth
items.summary: NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft has reached a historic milestone by traveling one light-day, or roughly 16 billion miles, away from Earth. This news marks the first time a human-made probe has achieved this distance, meaning radio signals traveling at the speed of light now require a full 24 hours each way to communicate with Earth.

items.headline: Carlos Alcaraz Defeats Daniil Medvedev at the ATP Finals in Turin
items.summary: Spanish tennis star Carlos Alcaraz defeated Daniil Medvedev 6-2, 6-4 on November 18 at the Nitto ATP Finals in Turin, Italy. The straight-sets victory extended Alcaraz's winning streak to 11 matches and brought him to the brink of qualifying for the tournament's semi-finals.

items.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI Launches Worldwide After a 13-Year Wait
items.summary: Rockstar Games has officially launched Grand Theft Auto VI, ending a 13-year gap since the franchise's previous entry in 2013. Industry analysts estimate the title generated over $1.5 billion in pre-orders, creating one of the largest entertainment launches in history.
